environment.description: Production deployment on EKS with the following: (1) The /usr/local/bin/hsm-verify binary is a PKCS#11 client linked to a CloudHSM cluster (hsm-cluster-abc123) via the cloudhsm-pkcs11 provider; key slot 3 contains an ECDSA P-256 signing key with label 'form-signing-key' provisioned per-user during hardware token enrollment - the verify operation requires a valid ECDSA signature over the exact form_data string. (2) The pod runs with a read-only root filesystem and a seccomp profile (runtime/default augmented with a custom BPF filter) that restricts the sendmail process to connect() only to the internal Postfix relay at 10.0.4.12:587 via an iptables NFQUEUE verdict coupled with a conntrack zone restriction - outbound SMTP to any other destination is dropped at the CNI level by a Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy (egress rule: toCIDR 10.0.4.12/32 port 587 only, all other port 25/587/465 denied). (3) The internal Postfix relay (10.0.4.12) is configured with header_checks using PCRE: /^(From|To|Cc|Bcc|Subject):.*[\r\n]/ REJECT and also enforces smtpd_data_restrictions with reject_multi_recipient_bounce.

config.pod_security: read-only rootfs, seccomp runtime/default + custom BPF
